expected.finding: **[P2]** `scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py`, `main()`: `--out-policy docs/improvement-policy-history.jsonl` passes the write guard. When a revision occurs, the script appends its history entry, then overwrites the entire history with the policy JSON. This destroys rollback snapshots and breaks subsequent history loading. Enforce separate, role-specific destinations before writing.

**[P2]** `scripts/render-rsi-dashboard.py`, `trigger_chart()`: History entries’ `version` values are interpolated directly into SVG markup without validation or escaping. A supplied `--history` file containing a version such as `</text><script>alert(1)</script><text>` produces executable markup in the dashboard. Escape these values at interpolation and validate history metadata.
